content.title:
Supporting IPMAT prep
*without the pressure.*
content.subtitle: Three things that help more than daily reminders.

qa.a: Regular beats long. A steady daily routine with one mock a week works better than long weekend sessions.

qa.q: Should I check on them every day?
qa.a: A short weekly check-in works better: what went well, what was hard, what is next.
A quiet study corner, fixed sleep hours and the phone kept away during study time.
qa.note: Encouragement after a bad mock does more than pressure after a good one.

caption:
Parents, three ways to support IPMAT prep without adding pressure 👇
